propositions: A single project's base-query transport error (400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 5xx, timeout) currently aborts the entire reconciler pass for all projects, preventing other projects' issues from being captured.
The 2026-08-15 outage was caused by a nonexistent project key (LEG) triggering an ACLI exit that halted ~12h of scheduled reconcile passes across all mapped projects.
Base-query loop lacks per-project error isolation that already exists in the enrichment loop (_enrich_project), creating asymmetric resilience.

A per-project transport failure must emit an observable fetcher-project-fetch-failed alert and continue to other projects, while syntactically-invalid keys and pagination stalls must still fail closed.
Partial keys from a failed project's mid-pagination state must never merge into the shared snapshot to avoid spurious deletion signals in the differ.
Single-project unseeded fallback path must remain regression-identical and never write empty all-deletions snapshots.
